name: mylo
description: MyLo — making the Rwanda Law Gazette readable, searchable and interactive.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run env:init
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix MyLo-Backend install && npm --prefix MyLo-frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm --prefix MyLo-Backend run lint && npm --prefix MyLo-frontend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix MyLo-Backend run format && npm --prefix MyLo-frontend run format
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix MyLo-Backend run typecheck && npm --prefix MyLo-frontend run typecheck
scripts.stack:up: docker compose -f MyLo-Backend/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
